glosses: dimension (a single aspect of a given thing)
dimension (a measure of spatial extent in a particular direction)

examples.en: What are the dimensions of the room?

examples.text: Eso le añade una nueva dimensión a nuestro problema.
examples.en: That adds a new dimension to our problem.

examples.text: Tom cree que el universo de verdad tiene once dimensiones.
examples.en: Tom believes that the universe really has eleven dimensions.
